page_title: Telemetry Control Plane for AI-Era Data Volumes

sources.entry: SLOs & You: A Guide To Service Level Objectives

summary.name: Apica
summary.one_liner: Apica is a telemetry control plane vendor that processes, routes, stores and tests telemetry data so enterprises can reduce observability costs and feed AI agents.
use_cases: Reducing Splunk, Datadog, or Dynatrace ingestion costs
Filtering and enriching telemetry before indexing
Routing telemetry to cheaper data lake storage
Providing real-time clean telemetry to AI agents
Meeting compliance requirements with zero data loss
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Apica as a telemetry infrastructure platform organized into several named components: Apica Fleet (collection), Apica Flow (control plane), Apica Lake (storage, powered by InstaStore), Apica Observe (intelligence), plus Apica Forge, Vanguard, Wayfinder and a Safety Net feature. Its stated approach is to process and enrich telemetry inside the pipeline before expensive ingestion, and route only data that needs indexing to costly platforms. It can store data in a customer's data lake or Apica's own storage. It also says it monitors multi-agent user journeys and automates testing. The page cites survey statistics on telemetry growth and costs but gives no pricing or technical specifications.
notable: Pipeline-side processing and routing that sends only indexable data to expensive platforms
Storage in customer data lake or Apica's InstaStore-powered lake
Named components spanning collection, control, storage, intelligence and testing planes
Recognized as a leader in QKS Group SPARK Matrix for Edge Telemetry Pipeline Platforms (Q3 2026)
caveats: Page is mostly marketing; pricing and supported platforms are not stated
Page content does not match the URL or the listing's described SLO guide; the indexed page is an Apica vendor page
Cost and growth statistics are vendor-supplied survey figures
